The '''Flame of Dagnoth''' is a [[fire elemental]] located in [[Grim Hollow]] in the [[Grim Reaches]]. It is the manifestation of the corruption within the [[Flame of Dagnoth (object)|Flame of Dagnoth]], an ancient well of dwarven magic. [[Yor'thegg the Wise]] seeks to expel the evil within the flame and destroy it to snuff out the corruption.

==Abilities==
* Fire Blast
* Blast Wave
